Subtle.$description: Barely-there element such as an inactive scroll affordance.

Base.$description: Minimum height of a standard form control box (48px at 16px root).

XS.$description: Minimum height of a compact (flat) control (28px at 16px root).

SM.$description: Minimum height of a small control (32px at 16px root).

LG.$description: Minimum height of a large control (56px at 16px root).

XL.$description: Minimum height of an extra-large control (72px at 16px root).

Indicator.$description: Size of a small grabbable/indicator control such as a slider thumb (24px at 16px root, meets WCAG 2.5.8 target size).

MD.$description: Minimum height of a medium control such as a tab or a carousel button (40px at 16px root).

Base.$description: Default inline icon/spinner size (24px at 16px root).

XS.$description: Small glyph rendered inside a control, such as a toggle's checkmark (12px at 16px root).

SM.$description: Small inline icon such as an accordion marker glyph (16px at 16px root).

Base.$description: Thickness of a track/rail such as a slider track (12px at 16px root).

Switch.$description: Width of a switch/toggle track (40px at 16px root).

Thumb.$description: Size of the thumb that travels along a switch/toggle track (16px at 16px root).

Dot.$description: Diameter of the selected dot inside a radio control (8px at 16px root).

XS.$description: Tight radius for small inline elements such as a flag thumbnail (2px at 16px root).

Danger.$description: Used for validation messages in forms

DangerDark.$description: One step lighter than Danger; used where invalid text sits on a danger-tinted surface.

DangerDarker.$description: One step darker than Danger; used for the active state of invalid unselected text.

UnderlineOffset.$description: Offset of text underlines (4px at 16px root).

SpinnerBackground.$description: Background color of the loading spinner's circle track inside a disabled button.

Size.$description: Size of the loading spinner inside the button.

Mobile.$description: Padding of a brand-icon button on mobile.

Tablet.$description: Padding of a brand-icon button from tablet up.

UnderlineOffset.$description: Underline offset of the link-colored button.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of a flat button.

Gap.$description: Gap between buttons in a button group.
Gap between the step buttons and the value display.

MinWidth.$description: Minimum width of the value display so single- and multi-digit values render at the same widget width.

Typo.$description: Typography of the counter value display. Only fontFamily and fontWeight are applied in code; fontSize/lineHeight stay inherited from context.

Danger.$description: Text color of the value display when the counter is in the danger/invalid state.

Padding.$description: Padding inside a tile, and the inset of its hint badge.

Gutter.$description: Gutter between tile columns in a multi-column group.

Background.$description: Fill of a checked tile in the default variant (base, hover and active share it).
Fill of a checked tile in the green variant (base, hover and active share it).
Fill of a checked tile in the red variant (base, hover and active share it).
Fill of a checked tile in the yellow variant (base, hover and active share it).
Fill of a checked tile in the purple variant (base, hover and active share it).

Gap.$description: Space between the radio control and its label.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of the radio row, keeping the touch target large enough.

Size.$description: Width and height of the radio control.

Block.$description: Vertical padding of the radio row.

Size.$description: Diameter of the dot shown when the radio is selected.

Stacked.$description: Gap between stacked radios in a group.

Inline.$description: Gap between radios laid out in a row from tablet up.

Gap.$description: Space between the switch and its label.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of the whole toggle row, keeping the touch target large enough.

Base.$description: Inset between the switch track and the thumb.

Block.$description: Vertical padding of the toggle row.

Size.$description: Size of the thumb that travels across the switch.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of the toggle row in dense mode.

Block.$description: Vertical padding of the toggle row in dense mode.

Size.$description: Size of the checkmark glyph revealed in the checked state.

TitleTypo.$description: Typography of the summary label when it is rendered as a title (`summary-title`).

1.$description: Typography of the summary label at visual heading level 1.

2.$description: Typography of the summary label at visual heading level 2.

3.$description: Typography of the summary label at visual heading level 3.

4.$description: Typography of the summary label at visual heading level 4.

5.$description: Typography of the summary label at visual heading level 5.

Gap.$description: Gap between the summary label and the marker.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of the accordion header, keeping the touch target large enough.

Size.$description: Height and minimum width of the expand/collapse marker glyph.

Width.$description: Width of the expand/collapse marker box.

Base.$description: Space reserved for a bottom-positioned button summary. Matches the base button height.

SM.$description: Space reserved for a bottom-positioned small button summary. Matches the small button height.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of a tab, keeping the touch target large enough.

Gap.$description: Space between a tab label and its icon or badge.

Radius.$description: Corner radius of the focus ring around a tab.

Size.$description: Reference size used to offset a slotted badge.
Width and height of a carousel scroll button.

Margin.$description: Space between a scroll button and the tablist.

Inactive.$description: Opacity of a scroll button that cannot scroll further.

MinHeight.$description: Minimum height of the panel area beside a vertical tablist.

VerticalPaddingY.$description: Vertical panel padding when the tablist is vertical.

Width.$description: Width of the tablist track and its indicator.

GapMobile.$description: Gap between a vertical tablist and its panel on mobile.

Offset.$description: Distance between the trigger element and the tooltip container.

XS.$description: Body text at the `xs` size step (`.is-xs`, `.is-x-small`).

XL.$description: Body text at the `xl` size step (`.is-xl`, `.is-x-large`).

2XL.$description: Body text at the `2xl` size step (`.is-2xl`, `.is-xx-large`).

3XL.$description: Body text at the `3xl` size step (`.is-3xl`, `.is-xxx-large`).

4XL.$description: Body text at the `4xl` size step (`.is-4xl`, `.is-xxxx-large`).

5XL.$description: Body text at the `5xl` size step (`.is-5xl`, `.is-xxxxx-large`).

Heading.$description: Heading-styled body text — the `heading` prop (`.is-heading`, `.is-title`). Only `fontFamily`, `fontWeight` and `lineHeight` are applied; the font size stays owned by the `size` prop.

Subtitle.$description: Subtitle-styled body text — the `subtitle` prop (`.is-subtitle`). Only `fontFamily`, `fontWeight` and `lineHeight` are applied; the font size stays owned by the `size` prop.

Regular.$description: Default font weight of body text (`.is-regular`).

Bold.$description: Font weight of emphasised text — the `bold` prop, `.is-bold`, and nested `<b>`/`<strong>`.

Radius.$description: Border radius of the country flag.

Empty.$description: Background color of the country flag placeholder when no country is selected.

Background.$description: Background color of the country picker popup.

Padding.$description: Padding of the country picker popup.

Radius.$description: Border radius of the country picker popup.

Border.$description: Border of the country picker popup.

ZIndex.$description: Stack order of the country picker popup.

Placeholder.$description: Placeholder text color of the country filter input.

IconSize.$description: Size of the search icon in the country filter.

Color.$description: Color of the country list scrollbar thumb.

Radius.$description: Border radius of the country list scrollbar thumb.

BorderWidth.$description: Border width of the country list scrollbar thumb.

Width.$description: Width of the country list scrollbar.

Radius.$description: Border radius of a country option.

Gap.$description: Gap between the flag and name in a country option.

Width.$description: Width of the focus ring inset offset.

PaddingX.$description: Horizontal padding of the number input segment.

Gap.$description: Gap between the flag and calling code in the country trigger.

Size.$description: Size of the trigger chevron icon.

12.$description: White at 12% — hover wash on a dark surface.

24.$description: White at 24% — active wash on a dark surface.

30.$description: White at 30% — subtle divider/track on a dark surface.

50.$description: White at 50% — hovered divider/indicator on a dark surface.
